 Hayley Williams Live in Manila 2027: Ticket Prices and Seat Plan Announced
 Entertainment and Celebrity News Events & Nightlife 
 November 19, 2026 
 Jia Pizarro Bote 
 Good news! The ticketing details for Hayley Williams’ “The Hayley Williams Show” in Manila are finally out.
 Photo: Hayley Williams via @colormebrian/Instagram
 Ovation Productions announced the ticket prices and seat plan for the upcoming show, slated for February 24, 2027, at the Smart Araneta Coliseum.
 The ticket prices are as follows: 
 Floor Standing: P8,800
 Patron A: P9,300
 Patron B: P7,800
 Lower Box: P6,800
 Upper Box: P4,800
 Gen Ad (Free Seating): P2,800
 The allocated tickets for Artist Presale, which ran from November 18 until November 19, have officially sold out. However, fans can still purchase tickets on November 20 for the general onsale via ticketnet.com.ph and Ticketnet outlets. 
 Hayley Williams rose to global prominence for being the lead singer and founding member of Paramore. The band is known for their hit tracks “Misery Business,” “The Only Exception,” and “Ain’t it Fun,” among others.
 Outside of her work in Paramore, the American singer-songwriter has released three studio albums. Her most recent album “Ego Death at a Bachelorette Party” was released under her own independent label Post Atlantic.
